question: Kanus-a kinahanglan mukuha ug clearance sa bombero para sa welding o hot works ug unsa ang kalainan sa project-based ug annual?
answer: Ang clearance na kinahanglan mukuha sa welding o hot works ay Fire Safety Clearance (FSCR). Ang mga proyekto sa new construction o renovation ang dapat mag-apply sa FSCR habang may ongoing construction ([S1]). Ang FSCR ay kinakailangan din sa regular annual fire safety inspection ng Building Administrator at Fire Safety Practitioner ([S2]).

ground_truth: Fire Safety Clearance for welding, cutting and other hot work operations shall be secured if required. Per Project Duration applies to new construction or renovation; the clearance should be applied for during construction after the conduct of fire safety inspection. Annual applies to business establishments requiring almost daily repair or maintenance due to the nature of their business or operations. The matrix marks the per-project row under FSEC and the annual row under the two renewal columns; blank cells are not exemption statements.
